name: Member's Mark Loaded Potato Soup with Bacon (Deli Tub Warning)
whyItWorks: Heavy soup base made with heavy whipping cream, melted cheddar cheese, smoky bacon fat, diced potatoes, and green onions. Heavy dairy fat and smoked cured meats are a frequent trigger for urgent diarrhea.
prepOrOrderInstructions: High Fat & Dairy Warning: Better to make simple mashed potatoes with broth at home instead of prepared loaded soup tubs.
